source_build: Authored. The short list of shapes a sentence that sets a world's budget for its minds may have, each a pattern of slots in order with the sentences it was written for, and the closed word lists of each slot. A sentence is planned only where the whole of it, in order, is one of these shapes; a word of one slot is allowed in that slot and nowhere else. In a pattern, <slot> is one entry of that slot's list and <slot>? may be absent; a plain word is that word; AMOUNTS is one amount, or an amount of each kind with or without 'and' between them, each with the hour after it where it is said; two amounts with 'or' or 'to' between them are a choice, which is asked about and never planned; FROM_TO is 'from' an amount 'to' an amount. A slot may state a direction for some of its words (the move slot does). A shape is added one at a time, with its sentences and a reason.
fallback: A sentence that is none of these shapes is asked about and never planned.

entries.name: please
entries.reason: The one word of asking a sentence may open or close with; it says nothing of how much.

entries.name: set
entries.reason: Verbs that set a figure, in the form of an instruction. A sentence that reports what the minds do is not made with these in this place.

entries.name: move
entries.reason: Verbs that move a figure. They stand only in the shapes where the amount follows the word to, or from one amount to another, since elsewhere the amount may be the size of the move. A word that says a direction is held to it: said with a figure on the other side of the world's budget now (lower to more than it is, raise to less), the figure is asked for.

entries.name: give
entries.reason: The verb that hands a figure to the minds, the world or the town, as in give the minds 40 cents; never to a being, a kind or everyone, and never to a budget noun, which would read as an amount added to it.

entries.name: let
entries.reason: The two verbs that permit spending; with them the subject of the closed list does the spending.

entries.name: modal
entries.reason: The words that make a sentence about the subject a rule and not a report: the minds may spend is a budget, the minds spend is what happened. Must and should are not among them: each may mean a floor, and a budget is a ceiling.

entries.name: spend
entries.reason: What the subject is let do with the figure. They stand only after let, allow or a modal, or as the first word of an instruction.

entries.name: spend_first
entries.reason: The two verbs an instruction may open with to set the figure itself, as in spend a dollar an hour on the minds.

entries.name: subject
entries.reason: The one closed list of whose figure it is: the minds, the models, this world or town, the budget itself, with their possessive forms as the reader's tokens spell them. No word here is one being, one kind or everyone, so a figure for each of something has no subject to stand on.

entries.name: budget
entries.reason: The entries of whose-figure-it-is that name a budget, a limit or a cap itself. The shapes that put a budget back to the default take these only: reset the budget is a budget's, reset the world is another request.

entries.name: given
entries.reason: The entries of whose-figure-it-is that a figure can be given to: the minds, the models, this world or town. Not a budget noun, not the spending, and not it.

entries.name: minds
entries.reason: The subjects that can be turned off: the minds and their spending. The world, the town and it are not among them, so stop the world is no budget of nothing.

entries.name: lead
entries.reason: Words that lead into a figure as the most that may be spent. None makes a floor, a total or a change.

entries.name: lead_bare
entries.reason: The same bounds from above where no verb stands before the amount, as in at most 600 decisions an hour.

entries.name: whom
entries.reason: What the money is for, said after the figure. Each names the minds as a whole; none names a being, a kind or everyone.

entries.name: budget_of
entries.reason: The words between give the minds and the figure, naming the figure as the budget.

entries.name: other_step
entries.reason: The few words of another step's clause, which may stand only among the names that step's options listed, before the word and that opens the budget's own clause.

entries.name: turn
entries.reason: The two verbs that turn the minds off.

entries.name: none
entries.reason: The words for a figure of nothing after set the budget to.

entries.name: to_default
entries.reason: The ways the default is named after reset or back.

entries.name: the_default
entries.reason: The default named after use.

entries.name: bare
examples: 50 cents an hour
600 decisions an hour
$2 and 3000 decisions an hour
at most 600 decisions an hour
$5 hourly for the minds
please 50 cents an hour
entries.reason: A bare amount or two, with or without the hour: the answer to the reader's own question. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: set
examples: Set the minds budget to $2 and 3000 decisions an hour
cap the minds at 40 cents an hour
Set it to $0.50 per hour
keep it at a dollar an hour
entries.reason: An instruction that sets the subject's figure to, at or up to an amount. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: move_to
examples: Raise the minds budget to 50 cents an hour
Lower the budget to 10 cents an hour
entries.reason: A figure moved to an amount; without the word to the amount may be the size of the move, which is no shape. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: move_from_to
examples: raise it from 25 cents to 50 cents
from 25 cents to 50 cents an hour
entries.reason: A figure moved from one amount to another; the first is what the budget is now, and is set aside only where it is. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: let
examples: Let this world spend up to 40 cents an hour on AI minds
Let the minds make 1,000 decisions an hour
Let the minds answer 600 times an hour
entries.reason: The subject is let spend, make or answer up to an amount. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: allow
examples: Allow 300 model decisions per hour and 20 cents
entries.reason: An amount allowed, with no subject said. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: may
examples: The minds may make at most 1,500 decisions an hour
entries.reason: A rule about the subject, made a rule by its modal: what the minds may spend, not what they spend. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: spend
examples: Spend a dollar an hour on the minds
entries.reason: An instruction that opens with spend or use and the figure. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: give
examples: Give the minds 40 cents
Give the minds a budget of 2 dollars
entries.reason: The minds, the world or the town is given a figure. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: nothing_spend
examples: Spend nothing on minds
entries.reason: Nothing is to be spent on the minds. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: nothing_stop
examples: Stop spending anything on AI minds
entries.reason: Spending on the minds is to stop. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: nothing_off
examples: Turn the minds off
Turn the minds' spending off
entries.reason: The minds or their spending turned off. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: nothing_off_first
examples: Turn off the minds
entries.reason: The same with off said first. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: nothing_stop_minds
examples: Stop the minds
entries.reason: The minds stopped. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: nothing_set
examples: Set the budget to nothing
Set the minds budget to zero
entries.reason: The subject's figure set to nothing in a word. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: default_reset
examples: Reset the minds budget
Reset the budget to its default
entries.reason: The subject's figure reset. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: default_back
examples: Put the minds budget back to the default
Put the budget back to its default
entries.reason: The subject's figure put back to the default. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: default_go_back
examples: Go back to the default
back to the default
entries.reason: Back to the default, with no subject said. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.

entries.name: default_use
examples: Use the default budget
entries.reason: The default asked for by name. It stands for exactly the sentences its pattern spells and no other order of the same words.
